item.title: Cal State University skilled trade workers go on strike
item.description: More than 1,000 skilled trade workers, including plumbers, electricians, HVAC techs, locksmiths and other building maintenance staff, started their strike today at campuses across the state. item.title: To better prevent veteran suicides, CSULB researchers seek to clarify their scope
item.description: The team hopes to standardize tracking and reporting — an urgent problem when veteran suicide rates are more than double that of the overall adult population in the U.S. The post To better prevent veteran suicides, CSULB researchers seek to clarify their scope appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: AI will soon listen to and review 911 calls in Long Beach
item.description: It will be used for quality assurance to make sure dispatchers are gathering all the necessary information for first responders. The post AI will soon listen to and review 911 calls in Long Beach appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: New CA bill seeks to stop local police from helping ICE racially profile or detain observers
item.description: The bill would ban local law enforcement from helping federal agents with operations based on racial profiling, efforts to stop First Amendment speech or actions involving unauthorized military weapons. item.title: Cash-strapped Long Beach warns of looming cuts as it projects deficit up to $80 million next year
item.description: Departments are already looking for ways to save money, and service reductions appear inevitable after slipping tax revenue and canceled federal grants left the city relying on reserves to balance its budget. item.title: Long Beach Unified cuts hundreds of contracted teaching jobs
item.description: The district has sought to avoid laying off permanent staff as it seeks to close a large budget gap. Nevertheless, teachers say these latest cuts will be felt in the classroom.
